value.desc: Function to call right away with the initial size, then whenever the outer size (padding and border included) of the element changes; false or null (or undefined) disables the directive (the observer is dropped and recreated when a handler is supplied again)

returns.desc: If you return Boolean false from the handler, the observer stops

arg.desc: Debounce in milliseconds; the element is measured at most once per window, so the last change is never missed; 0 (the default) measures on every change

once.desc: Call handler only once, with the initial size, then stop observing
